episodeTitle.en: My favorite interview questions from 100+ guests
episodeTitle.zh: 我从100+位嘉宾那里收集的最爱采访问题

guestBioOfficial.en: This is a special episode of the podcast where I've curated my favorite interview questions from over a hundred podcast guests. Whether you're a hiring manager, a job seeker, or simply intrigued by the brilliant minds behind groundbreaking products, these questions offer unique insights into the strategies and philosophies that shape successful interviews.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 本期播客特别环节，我精心挑选了百余位播客嘉宾中最受欢迎的采访问题。无论你是招聘经理、求职者，还是对突破性产品背后的杰出人才感兴趣，这些问题都能为成功面试的策略与理念提供独特见解。

title.en: My favorite interview questions from 100+ guests
title.zh: 我从100+位嘉宾那里收集的最爱采访问题

summary.en: Rather than a single interview, this episode curates the most useful interview guidance from across the podcast's guest roster into one focused listen. It distills practical tips on answering behavioral and product-design questions, showcasing your thinking, and standing out to hiring managers. It's a handy resource for anyone preparing for their next product, design, or engineering interview.
summary.zh: 这期并非单次访谈，而是把播客嘉宾阵容中最实用的面试指导精选编排成一期聚焦的节目。它提炼了回答行为与产品设计问题、展示思维方式、以及向招聘经理脱颖而出的实用技巧。对任何准备下一场产品、设计或工程面试的人来说，都是一份便利的参考资料。
